subject.name: Saint Peter Claver, Priest
subject.blurb: Saint Peter Claver was a Spanish Jesuit who spent forty years at Cartagena, the main slave port of the Spanish Americas, meeting arriving ships to bring food, water, and medical care to the enslaved Africans aboard before catechizing them. He called himself the slave of the Africans forever, is said to have baptized some 300,000 people, and was canonized in 1888.
subject.notification: St. Peter Claver, pray for us!
